detailTitle: Honda Research Institute USA - Code Intelligence
title: Research Extern, Code Intelligence
description: Building repository-scale code question answering systems using hybrid retrieval and graph-augmented reasoning, with large-scale benchmarking on HPC.
achievements: Built a Git Intelligence Layer for repository Q&A by representing codebases as heterogeneous knowledge graphs (files/classes/functions) with structural edges (contains/imports/invokes/inherits) to enable multi-hop, cross-file reasoning

Designed a hybrid retrieval stack combining BM25, dense retrieval, and intent-aware graph traversal; evaluated on DeepCodeBench repository Q&A (1,144 Q&A instances) and reported gains over lexical-only and context-only baselines
Ran large-scale benchmarking on HPC (SLURM), comparing GPT/Qwen/Llama families using an LLM-as-judge pipeline for fact-level scoring; analyzed retrieval design trade-offs and judge-model sensitivity

title: Founding Engineer & Senior Software Developer
description: Led backend development and DevOps for a growing startup, building scalable systems from the ground up. Responsible for architecting microservices, implementing automation workflows, and mentoring engineering teams.
achievements: Developed 100+ RESTful APIs using Java Spring Boot in microservices architecture
Built comprehensive SQL and NoSQL data access layers with JPA/Hibernate and MongoRepository
Automated 200+ n8n workflows, enabling 3x faster business operation execution
Engineered AWS Lambda + S3 pipeline generating 50+ contract PDFs daily
Migrated 90+ MongoDB collections to PostgreSQL for advanced analytics
Reduced application downtime by 40% through Prometheus and Grafana monitoring
Mentored a team of 6 engineers, fostering skill development and knowledge sharing

title: Software Intern
description: Worked on data engineering and software quality improvements, improving reliability and reducing manual reporting effort for finance workflows.
achievements: Implemented ETL scripts to ingest and cleanse finance logs from Azure Blob Storage into PostgreSQL, cutting report preparation time by 35%
Refactored a legacy module into modular components, increasing unit test coverage from 38% to 82% and simplifying onboarding for new developers

title: Operations Analyst, Logistics Team
description: Devised an end-to-end solution to deploy hydra crane PAN India for Reliance; Received Letter of Recommendation.
achievements: Negotiated with 35+ vendors to provide logistic service at 150+ locations in India for project worth INR 120M (Strategic Cost Reduction)
Reduced operations cost by 20% through targeted outreach of 3PL Vendors and streamlining the process flow (Strategic Cost Reduction)
Analyzed strategies to integrate blockchain with supply chain, resulting in increased transparency in operations (Strategic Cost Reduction)
